To find the maximum routed distance, we can calculate the energy available for the trip and divide it by the vehicle's consumption rate.

1. **Calculate the energy available for the trip (excluding the 12% reserve):**
   $$\text{Reserve Energy} = 58\text{ kWh} \times 0.12 = 6.96\text{ kWh}$$
   $$\text{Available Energy} = 58\text{ kWh} - 6.96\text{ kWh} = 51.04\text{ kWh}$$

2. **Calculate the consumption rate per kilometer:**
   $$\text{Consumption Rate} = \frac{18.5\text{ kWh}}{100\text{ km}} = 0.185\text{ kWh/km}$$

3. **Calculate the maximum routed distance:**
   $$\text{Maximum Distance} = \frac{51.04\text{ kWh}}{0.185\text{ kWh/km}} \approx 275.89\text{ km}$$

The maximum routed distance is approximately **275.89 kilometers** (or about 276 km).
